title: Basis-Month Credit on Pre-K Tuition: Amount and Limit
content:
**Clause.** On a Pre-K tuition account of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the credit for the basis month (the enrollment's most recent billing month when the eligibility basis comes on file) is figured as follows.

1. The basis-month credit is posted against the tuition charged for the basis month. It is read from the child's School Nutrition Services Meal Account in status active as that account stands on the day the credit is posted.
2. The basis-month credit is 0.00, the basis month remaining owed.
3. A child has no basis-month credit at all, and nothing is booked, when any of these holds: the child's meal account in status active holds no Free Meal Status or Reduced-Price Meal Status tier; the child has no such account; or the tier took effect in a month after the enrollment's most recent billing month.
4. The credit is never more than the basis month's tuition charge.
5. The basis-month schedule's amounts are applied in one order: first the method that applies, then additions, then the limit to the basis month's tuition charge. Only that final amount is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

## Judging the basis month

| The child's meal account in status active, on the day the credit is posted | Basis-month credit |
|---|---|
| holds a Free Meal Status or Reduced-Price Meal Status tier that took effect in or before the basis month | 0.00; the basis month remains owed |
| holds Paid Meal Status | none |
| holds a free or reduced-price tier that took effect in a month after the basis month | none |
| no active meal account | none |
